title: Melnikov's Valency Variety Problem
summary: Let $w(G)$ denote the number of distinct vertex degrees of a finite simple graph $G$. Melnikov asked for a lower bound on the chromatic number $χ(G)$ in terms of $|V(G)|$ and $w(G)$, and conjectured a strict bound of this type. We resolve Melnikov's valency-variety problem by proving that every graph $G$ with at least two vertices satisfies \begin{equation*} χ(G)\ge\left\lceil1+\frac{2w(G)(w(G)-1)}{4w(G)(|V(G)|-w(G))+(|V(G)|-w(G)-1)^2}\right\rceil, \end{equation*} and consequently \begin{equation*} χ(G)\ge\left\lceil\frac{\lfloor w(G)/2\rfloor}{|V(G)|-w(G)}\right\rceil. \end{equation*}…
